name: Lydda
overview: Lydda, also called Lod, was a city within the territory of the tribe of Benjamin, mentioned in the post-exilic community records in Ezra and Nehemiah. In the New Testament, it is notably the place where the Apostle Peter healed Aeneas, a man bedridden for eight years, by the power of Jesus Christ. This miraculous healing led many inhabitants of Lydda and nearby Sharon to turn to the Lord, highlighting the city's role in the early spread of the gospel.
